lines.ruling: Ruling: representation; f1099div p. 5, Box 5, "Shows the portion of the amount in box 1a that may be eligible for the 20% qualified business income deduction under section 199A". As ruled on 2026-11-14, 2026-11-15 and 2026-11-22: the project copies qbi.dividends_if_ordinary, asked only when box 1a is above zero, while the reply copies qbi.dividends directly; box 5 is a portion of box 1a, so the two agree wherever the interview asks the amount. The review was occasioned by the new refusal entry on this line (qbi.unreported_loss_if_business, BUG-1061, i8995a p. 6), which the reply's expression does not carry and the refusal comparison covers; the value expression is unchanged.

Ruling: representation; equivalent on executable triage, ruled mechanically: the project's line and the reply's agree on every input triage ran (3310 values compared, none different or missing: 2636 on 2636 fixture cases, 500 on 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 174 on 174 partial records; policy executable-triage-v2). No agent read the source; one in 10 such disagreements is held for adjudication instead.

Ruling: model error; f8995 p. 1, line 12, "Enter your net capital gain, if any, increased by any qualified dividends", and i8995 p. 4, Line 12, "line 3a, plus your net capital gain": the candidate omits the qualified dividends (Form 1040 line 3a), which the project adds through f1040.line3a_if_ordinary. Ruled by reading: the scoped reply names interfaces the candidate bank does not resolve, as in the earlier line-scoped passes of this lane.

Ruling: representation; f8995 p. 1, "Use this form if your taxable income, before your qualified business income deduction, is at or below $197,300 ($394,600 if married filing jointly)". As ruled on 2026-11-14 and 2026-11-22: both choose Form 8995 line 15 at or under the threshold and Form 8995-A above it; the reply reads Form 8995 line 11 where the project reads qbi.taxable_before through qbi.use_8995a, the same figure (Form 8995 line 11 is qbi.taxable_before). The reply's note on patrons, suspended losses and a REIT/PTP carryforward describes refusals the project makes through qbi.unsupported (now asking the patron question only with a Schedule C or section 199A dividends, i8995 p. 1, Who Can Take the Deduction). No change to the data.
